'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 David Runyon LS Thrown Back (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David Runyon]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Thrown Back (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|OVS8-21-Thrown_Back-remaster.webp|label=Thrown Back (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
